_doc: Regression scenarios. Each scenario runs in its own fresh CLI session on the test bot. Checks are regexes against each bot reply. 'serial' scenarios touch topic state and run one at a time after the parallel ones. post.state_reason checks data/state/<pid>.json after the scenario.
